segments.title: Birthday Elden Ring: Notorious Sex Guy Science Eyes Build
segments.notes: Solo birthday gaming broadcast; Case advances arcane/faith build, defeats Godrick, obtains Frenzied Burst incantation, pledges to Mohg, and reaches Mohgwyn Palace farming spot; 20 gifted subs from tamtran push stream past eight-hour debate marathon goal.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: anchor. Solo birthday stream playing Elden Ring; advanced arcane/faith 'notorious sex guy' build, beat Godrick, secured Frenzied Burst, allied with Mohg, and hit debate marathon sub goal.

lore_notes.fact: tamtran gifts 20 subs, completing the eight-hour debate marathon goal.
Case acquires Howl of Shibiri / Frenzied Burst (science eyes incantation).
Case allies with Mohg, Lord of Blood, receiving Mohg's Great Rune.
Case reaches Mohgwyn Palace ledge road grace for albinauric rune farming.
Raid target: Not Sage (podcast with Candle, No Pixel/Pixel Circus).

episode_summary: Case Blackwell marks his birthday with a solo Elden Ring playthrough, piloting an arcane/faith 'notorious sex guy' build through Stormveil to a Godrick victory, then chasing the Frenzied Flame incantation and Mohg's oath before settling at the Mohgwyn Palace albinauric farm. A 20-sub gift from tamtran clears the eight-hour debate marathon goal, and the broadcast closes with a raid to Not Sage.
